name: Entity Version
description: Provides a way to store and keep track of the version of content entities as a major.minor.patch number.
project_description: Entity Version provides an 'entity_version' field type that stores a structured version number (major, minor and patch as three unsigned-integer columns) on content entities. Editors set the numbers with a simple three-part number widget and display them with a formatter that joins them down to a configurable minimum category (major / major.minor / major.minor.patch). A per entity-type-and-bundle 'entity_version_settings' config entity marks one version field as the 'main' field so sub-modules know which field to act on; the settings form lives at /admin/config/entity-version/settings behind the 'administer entity version' permission. An EntityVersionInstaller service can attach the field programmatically. The field item exposes increase(), decrease() and reset() methods per category that third-party code and the 'entity_version_workflows' sub-module use to change the numbers, and the 'entity_version_history' sub-module adds a per-entity History tab listing the distinct versions across revisions.
